programme.desc: S01 E07 — Poison Paradise Blake and Margo stumble upon a home with a dead oak and a violation notice. A disabled veteran and a former government worker have fallen behind with upkeep, so the team creates a safe, stress-free yard for them and their dogs.
programme.title: Worst Yard on the Block

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Forgotten Yard to Thriving Hub Tucker and J. Paul get a lead on a Craftsman bungalow whose charm has been overrun by bushes. Once a lively family hub, the home's now just a dusty and empty nest, so the team arrives to bring life, fun and connection back to this forgotten yard.
programme.title: Worst Yard on the Block

programme.desc: S01 E03 — The Feral Frontier A cat lady with a wild yard lands on Blake and Margo's radar; looking after 20 feral cats, her yard has been overtaken by invasive plants and weeds, so the team comes in to create a beautiful, safe space for all her feline friends.
programme.title: Worst Yard on the Block

programme.desc: S01 E02 — A Leaky Situation After hiring four different contractors, a couple calls on Mike, Michael and Sherry to solve the mystery of the ongoing leak; Mike and Sherry visit a family who desperately needs to make their home accessible for their son.
programme.title: Holmes Family Rescue

programme.desc: S01 E04 — We Have Lift Off Just as a homeowner was about to give birth, she and her partner were scammed by a contractor who left them with a mess of a kitchen; before the Holmes family can make the home accessible, they must fix the dangerous structural issues left behind.
programme.title: Holmes Family Rescue

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Accessibility Denied A motorcycle racer is waving the white flag after an intimidating contractor scared her off of renovations; in order to help, the Holmes family must contend with dangerous gas leaks, shoddy workmanship and a main floor that's stuck in the '80s.
programme.title: Holmes Family Rescue

programme.desc: S16 E04 — A House Fit for a Queen A mother of three boys wants to sell the house they've called home for eight years; her oldest hopes to change her mind; he loves the property and his mom's short commute.
programme.title: Love It or List It

programme.desc: S17 E05 — Parents and the Pantry Anu and Samir rushed their first house purchasing shortly after getting married; Samir can't believe their luck in finding a home in this location, but Anu thinks they may have overlooked big issues in their rush to buy.
programme.title: Love It or List It

programme.desc: S21 E10 — Worth The Risk? After 18 years, a couple's starter home is showing wear and tear from busy family life. He believes it's finally time to move, but she thinks they have renovation potential.
programme.title: Love It or List It

programme.desc: S20 E08 — Family Home vs. New Horizons A couple who raised two kids is now transitioning into retirement; both of their children are coming back home, and he wants Page to renovate to accommodate their return; however, she thinks David can find a place that's more manageable.
programme.title: Love It or List It

programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Nineties Are Back Two teams of beloved '90s TV icons scour America in search of homes that are stuck in the past; and once they choose their house, they'll go head-to-head in a renovation competition, and it all begins with taking on some totally '90s kitchens.
programme.title: Totally '90s House

programme.desc: S03 E12 — Sleigh All Day Jack visits an old flour mill that's been restored into a private residence; he also gets into the holiday spirit by touring a Christmas-themed log cabin and exploring a replica of the Palace of Versailles.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E13 — Large and In Charge Jack explores an aviation-inspired home built on a lot previously leveled by wildfire; after an update about a successful wild home sale, Jack goes south to visit a replica of the White House.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Enchanted Forest Jack sets off on a wanderlust adventure touring forest hideaways, and first is a family's fairytale cottage; then, he visits a husband's dream home for his wife and a property that's an ever-evolving, livable artwork.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Rock Out Jack's wild adventures continue as he tours a townhome that's a love letter to Asheville, N.C.; he visits a crisp multi-dome that can withstand a natural disaster and tours a desert home that's carved into a mountain's natural bedrock.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E16 — Strap In for Fun Jack heads to New York and tours a Manhattan townhouse with a big rock climbing wall; and after an update from a Palm Springs palace he toured in the past, he checks out a California home that invites bold exploration.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S276 E03 — Antiques and Age Gaps in Tulsa A couple with a 16-year age gap disagrees on what type of house to buy in Tulsa, Okla.; he's in his 40s and loves the charm of vintage homes, but she's in her 20s and prefers a modern new build.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S274 E17 — Our Own Worst Enemies For three years, a couple has fought a tough market and each other to buy in their hometown of Berlin, Conn.; she refuses to settle and he refuses to spend, so it may take some hard truths to bring them together.

One of the smallest houses the team has taken on offers up big challenges: with a family stuck in a tiny home, unable to deal with their grief, the team along with generous West Bromwich volunteers step in to drastically improve this family's home.
programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
